pairs: But if I may contend with you,
while still speaking what is just to you:
Why does the way of the impious prosper?
Why is it well with all those who transgress and act unfairly?
You are near to their mouths,
and you have tested my heart with you.
Congrega eos quasi gregem ad victimam,
Gather them together like a flock for the sacrifice
et sanctifica eos in die occisionis.
and sanctify them for the day of slaughter.
How long shall the earth mourn?
et herba omnis regionis siccabitur, propter malitiam habitantium in ea?
And how long shall the plants of every field whither because of the wickedness of the inhabitants within them?
It has consumed the wild animals and the birds.
quoniam dixerunt: Non videbit novissima nostra.
For they said: “He will not see our very end.”
“If you have struggled to run on foot,
how will you be able to compete with horses?
cum autem in terra pacis securus fueris,
And if you have been secure in a land of peace,
what will you do about the arrogance of the Jordan?
and the house of your father,
even these have fought against you.
et clamaverunt post te plena voce:
And they have cried out after you with loud voice:
when they speak good things to you.’”
dedi dilectam animam meam in manu inimicorum ejus.
I have given my beloved soul into the hand of its enemies.
Facta est mihi hæreditas mea quasi leo in silva:
My inheritance has become for me like a lion in the forest.
It has uttered a voice against me,
Numquid avis discolor hæreditas mea mihi?
Is my inheritance to me like a discolored bird?
Is it like a bird that has entirely changed color?
Pastores multi demoliti sunt vineam meam,
Many pastors have demolished my vineyard.
dederunt portionem meam desiderabilem in desertum solitudinis.
They have made my desirable portion into a desert of solitude.
and it has grieved concerning me.
The entire earth has become utterly desolate,
quia nullus est qui recogitet corde.
because there is no one who understands with the heart.”
Super omnes vias deserti venerunt vastatores,
The devastators have arrived, over all the ways of the wilderness.
For the sword of the Lord will devour,
ab extremo terræ usque ad extremum ejus,
from one end of the earth even to its furthest limits.
There is no peace for all that is flesh.
but it will not benefit them.
Confundemini a fructibus vestris propter iram furoris Domini.
You will be confounded by your own fruits, because of the wrath of the fury of the Lord.
Hæc dicit Dominus adversum omnes vicinos meos pessimos,
Thus says the Lord against all my wicked neighbors,
qui tangunt hæreditatem quam distribui populo meo Israël:
who touch the inheritance that I have distributed to my people Israel:
Ecce ego evellam eos de terra sua,
“Behold, I will root them out of their own land,
et domum Juda evellam de medio eorum.
and I will root the house of Judah out of their midst.
And when I have rooted them out,
And I will lead them back,
and another man to his land.
si eruditi didicerint vias populi mei,
if they are taught and they learn the ways of my people,
so that they swear by my name,
sicut docuerunt populum meum jurare in Baal,
just as they had taught my people to swear by Baal,
then they will be built up in the midst of my people.
But if they will not listen,
evellam gentem illam evulsione et perditione,
I will uproot that nation unto utter destruction and perdition,
